newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson names Butzer as Mervyn's head.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson names Butzer as Mervyn's head.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said Thursday it named Bart Butzer as president of its Mervyn's division, succeeding Paul Sauser, who is leaving the retailer.

The appointment takes effect March 17. Butzer, who began his career with Dayton Hudson as a Target merchandise manager in 1983, has held various positions. In 1991 he was named a regional senior vice president of Target Stores and currently has responsibility for more than 200 stores.

For the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, Mervyn's operating profit rose 73 percent to $109 million before a $114 million charge related to real estate repositioning, compared with $63 million in fourth quarter 1995.
Mervyn's full-year operating profit before the charge was $267 million compared with $100 million in 1995.

Mervyn's revenues decreased nine percent in the quarter and three percent for the year, the company said. Same-store revenues were down seven percent for the fourth quarter and four percent for the year.
